definition: A basic type of feedforward neural network consisting of multiple layers of neurons, each fully connected to the next, capable of modeling non-linear relationships.
details: MLPs are a foundational neural network architecture and remain common building blocks within more complex architectures, such as the feedforward sub-layers within transformer blocks.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. In plain words: A basic type of feedforward neural network consisting of multiple layers of neurons, each fully connected to the next, capable of modeling non-linear relationships. Here is how it actually plays out: MLPs are a foundational neural network architecture and remain common building blocks within more complex architectures, such as the feedforward sub-layers within transformer blocks. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Multilayer Perceptron.
